'''2025 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship at Zu Den Vier Winden in Bochum, Germany, 20–21 September 2025. [[Emil Wallin]] won.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-08-european-championship-bochum-germany-sept-20-21-2025/</ref>

This year is listed with other ECs on [[European Championships]].

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 20–21 September 2025
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1561 2025 European Championship Forum]
